name: Nolzur's Marvelous Pigments

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Paint

params.text: paints an object of up to 1,000 cubic feet into reality

powers.text: It paints an object of up to 1,000 cubic feet into reality. (No other effect in the game.)

summary: Paint objects (a door, a bridge, a tree) and they become real.
text: Typically found in 1d4 pots inside a fine wooden box with a brush, these pigments allow you to create three-dimensional objects by painting them in two dimensions. The paint flows from the brush to form the desired object as you concentrate on its image. Each pot of paint is sufficient to cover 1,000 square feet of a surface, which lets you create inanimate objects or terrain features with a total volume of up to 10,000 cubic feet. Nothing created by the pigments can have a value greater than 25 GP. (In the game, the party can paint a bridge, a door or a ladder where the story allows.)
